The *Parappasādakattheraapadāna* is a verse narrative preserved in the Therāpadāna section of the Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. The text recounts the spiritual lineage, past deeds, and meritorious acts of the elder (thera) Parappasādaka. SuttaCentral lists translations of this text into five languages [SuttaCentral].

Extensive shared passages are found in both its second volume (*Dutiyo bhāgo*, particularly segments §0.3–9.3) and its first volume (*Paṭhamo bhāgo*, segments §8.1–9.3) [DharmaNexus].
